question: Can contemporaneous stop-night conditions shared across taxa explain the residual within-taxon concentration and route-night dependence?
population: Exactly the 2,835 weather-eligible strictly-prior-history pairs and strongest fixed 72-h-rainfall q matrices.

common_stop_night_effect.unit: focal pair x wet stop x target taxon
common_stop_night_effect.training_outcomes: At a focal wet stop, use only the wet calling-presence outcomes of all other fixed-support taxa in that pair.
common_stop_night_effect.model: One penalized logistic calibration intercept delta_j,-s shared across the other taxa at that stop.
common_stop_night_effect.penalty: Fixed Gaussian/ridge penalty 0.5 * delta^2 with lambda=1.0.
common_stop_night_effect.fallback: delta=0 when fewer than 3 other taxa are available.
common_stop_night_effect.application: Apply delta_j,-s to the target taxon's fixed q at that stop only.
common_stop_night_effect.interpretation: Captures contemporaneous stop-wide conditions that affect multiple taxa, including unmeasured local weather/hydrology, route-order/time effects, or shared observation conditions, without using the target taxon's own wet outcome.

pair_rematching: After all leave-one-taxon-out stop shifts are applied, solve one common pair-level logit shift so expected total wet incidence again matches the observed total.

simulation.generator: Independent Bernoulli from the leave-one-taxon-out stop-hotness-adjusted, pair-rematched q.

endpoints.concentration: Existing conditional within-taxon concentration residual controlling route-new-taxon and extra-stop coefficients.
endpoints.bounded_dependence: Existing bounded rho_b among dry-route-silent taxa.
endpoints.far_lag: Existing pooled stop-number lag 7-9 coefficient among dry-route-silent taxa.

decision.stop_night_hotness_sufficient: All three observed endpoints fall within the adjusted independent-null reference intervals.
decision.residual_species_route_night_structure: Concentration remains above its upper residual bound and bounded/far-lag dependence remain above their upper null bounds.

interpretation.residual: Shared contemporaneous stop-night hotness across taxa is insufficient; the remaining structure requires a taxon-specific route-night x place component or another process not shared uniformly across taxa.
interpretation.sufficient: A substantial part of the apparent species-night structure can be explained by contemporaneous stop-wide conditions shared across taxa.
interpretation.boundary: This is a deliberately strong post-hoc common-cause adjustment using other taxa from the same wet survey; it is not independent prediction and does not identify which stop-night variable generated the shared hotness.

anti_tuning: Do not change leave-one-taxon-out rule, penalty lambda=1, bounds, minimum-other-taxa threshold, pair rematching, simulation count, seed, endpoint definitions or tails after readback.
